title: run_script: many tool calls in one step
description: Runs a short JavaScript program on the user's device, for work that needs many tool calls, such as checking every page of a search. The program is the body of an async function. It calls this site's tools as `await tools.<name>(arguments)`, which returns the tool's result or throws an Error whose message says what went wrong. It has no network, timers or modules, and its tool calls count toward the same limits as yours. It must return a small object, at most 10,000 characters as JSON: the IDs to show and a short summary of what it checked, never copies of whole results. IDs it returns can be shown with the presentation tools.

source.description: The body of an async function: await each tool call, and return an object.
